basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Wellington, New Zealand. I work as a software developer, and in my spare time, I enjoy exploring new games, especially simulation and strategy genres. I'm a regular on forums discussing modding and game optimization. I dislike online-only games that don't offer offline modes. I usually browse Reddit during evenings after work and on weekends. Currently single and enjoy the comfort of a small group of close friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science from the University of Auckland and have been working in the tech industry for over five years. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and self-taught skills, particularly around game development and modding. I frequently visit forums and community boards to stay updated on gaming trends and tech advancements.
